name: Narugasaki Kanna
source:
Kanna is a returnee student who spent most of her life and school years abroad. Her grandfather is American and used to be a quarterback. She had recently transferred back to Japan to [url=/c15917]Takaya[/url]'s school at an unusual time of the year. She currently lives in her family's shrine, "Narugasaki Shrine", and works there as a miko.

Actually, Kanna is pretty shy because she is not used to the life in Japan. Kanna likes giving others cute nicknames.
